content: argparse.ArgumentError: argument --browser: conflicting option string is a well-documented class of pytest plugin conflict (confirmed in seleniumbase's own GitHub discussions/issues) — occurs whenever two installed pytest plugins register the same CLI option (e.g. both pytest-playwright and seleniumbase define --browser). Standard fixes: uninstall one plugin, isolate in separate venvs, or disable one via -p no:<plugin> in pytest.ini/addopts. Given this repo already has seleniumbase installed for FBref scraping and disables both plugins in pytest.ini, the clean fix is to NOT use pytest-playwright at all and instead run Playwright E2E via the native Node test runner (@playwright/test), which has its own CLI (npx playwright test) entirely separate from pytest's argument parser — eliminating the conflict at the source.
